sentences.text: Sandip Mandal @ Sandip Mondal @ Rahul vs Unknown

In Re:- An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code
 of Criminal Procedure in connection with Nabagram P. S.
 Case No.100 of 2022 dated 23.03.2022 under Sections
 498A/302/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code adding
Sections 25(i)(a)/27 of the Arms Act (G.R. Case No.813 of
 2022)
 And

In the matter of : Sandip Mandal @ Sandip Mondal @ Rahul
 .... Petitioner
 Mr. Moyukh Mukherjee,
 Mr. Abhijit Singh,
 Mr. Sarthak Mondal

... for the Petitioner  Mr. Partha Pratim Das,
 Mrs. Manasi Roy  ... for the State  1.
Petitioner submits he has been falsely implicated in the case.
2. Learned counsel for the State opposes the bail prayer.
3. Petitioner is the husband of the victim lady.
Victim lady was murdered at the matrimonial home.
In view of the incriminating materials and the gravity of offence, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
4. Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is rejected.
5. Parties shall communicate a copy of this order to the trial court for due compliance.

(Gaurang Kanth, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
